knowledgeBase.title: Check-in and Check-out Times

facts.earlyCheckIn: Subject to room readiness upon arrival; luggage storage is always complimentary.
facts.lateCheckOut: Available upon request until 1:00 PM for a $40 fee, subject to availability.

knowledgeBase.summary: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM. Front desk is staffed 24 hours. Luggage storage is complimentary.

knowledgeBase.title: Breakfast Policy & Dining Hours

facts.serviceStyle: Artisan continental buffet & warm à la carte kitchen options
facts.location: The Garden Conservatory on the ground floor

knowledgeBase.summary: Breakfast is served in The Garden Conservatory (6:30-10:00 AM weekdays, 7:00-11:00 AM weekends). It is $18 per guest, but included complimentary with King Deluxe and Executive Family Suite bookings.

knowledgeBase.title: Swimming Pool

facts.amenitiesProvided: Fresh towels, loungers, and filtered water dispensers poolside

knowledgeBase.summary: Aster House features an indoor heated saltwater pool open daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Towels are provided poolside.

knowledgeBase.title: Fitness Center

facts.hours: Open 24 hours daily with guest room keycard access

knowledgeBase.summary: A 24-hour fitness center is accessible with your keycard, equipped with Peloton bikes, treadmills, ellipticals, and free weights.

knowledgeBase.title: Parking Facilities & Valet

facts.evCharging: Two Level-2 EV charging stations available complimentary for valet guests
facts.oversizedVehicles: Self-parking garage located one block away on 2nd Ave for vehicles over 7ft clearance

knowledgeBase.summary: Valet parking is available for $35 per night with unlimited in/out privileges and complimentary Level-2 EV charging.

knowledgeBase.title: Pet Policy

facts.rules: Up to 2 dogs per room. Pets must be leashed in public spaces. Service animals are exempt from fees and weight restrictions.
facts.amenitiesForPets: Complimentary dog bed, bowls, and organic treats provided at check-in

knowledgeBase.summary: Dogs up to 45 lbs are welcome (up to 2 per room) for a one-time fee of $50 per stay. Service animals are exempt from fees.

knowledgeBase.title: Cancellation & Deposit Policy

facts.standardCancellationNotice: 48 hours prior to 3:00 PM local arrival date
facts.lateCancellationPenalty: One night's room and tax fee
facts.depositRequired: Credit card authorization held at check-in ($50 incidental deposit per night)

knowledgeBase.summary: Reservations may be cancelled without penalty up to 48 hours before check-in (3:00 PM). Cancellations within 48 hours incur a one-night fee.

knowledgeBase.title: Wi-Fi & Internet Access

facts.coverage: All guest rooms, meeting spaces, and public hotel areas
facts.loginRequired: Select 'AsterHouse-Guest' and enter room number and last name

knowledgeBase.summary: Complimentary high-speed fiber Wi-Fi is available across all rooms and public spaces without tiered paywalls.

knowledgeBase.title: Hotel Contact, Location & Front Desk
knowledgeBase.summary: Aster House is located at 142 Walnut Street in the Downtown Historic District. The front desk can be reached 24/7 at +1 (555) 328-9100 or frontdesk@asterhousehotel.com.

knowledgeBase.title: Children & Family Accommodations

facts.cribsAvailable: Complimentary Pack 'n Play cribs available upon advance request
facts.rollawayBeds: $25/night, available for King Deluxe and Suite rooms only
facts.childStayPolicy: Children aged 12 and under stay free when using existing bedding

knowledgeBase.summary: Children 12 and under stay free using existing bedding. Complimentary cribs are available upon request; rollaway beds are $25/night in King and Suite rooms.
